name: What maintenance is required after fiber cement siding repair?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required after fiber cement siding repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After fiber cement siding repair, it's essential to perform regular maintenance to ensure its longevity. This includes routine cleaning with a soft brush and mild detergent to remove dirt and mildew. Periodically inspect the repaired areas and the rest of the siding for any new signs of cracking, chipping, or sealant failure. Promptly address any issues by re-caulking or touching up paint to prevent moisture infiltration and maintain the siding's protective qualities and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: After repair, regularly clean your fiber cement siding and inspect for new cracks, chips, or sealant failures to maintain its protective qualities.
